            function switchGMTab(el, cat) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.gm-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                el.classList.add('active');
                activeGMTab = cat;
                const filtered = allQuestions.filter(q => q.gm_category === cat);
                renderSections(filtered);
                document.querySelector('.def-panel').style.display = 'none'; // hide def panel
            }

            function switchImpactTab(el, theme) {
                document.querySelectorAll('#impactTabsWrap .gm-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                el.classList.add('active');
                activeImpactTab = theme;
                const filtered = allQuestions.filter(q => q.theme === theme);
                renderSections(filtered);
                document.querySelector('.def-panel').style.display = 'none';
            }

            function formatGMCode(code) {
                if (!code) return '';
                // SI_1_1 â†’ 1.1, EC_2_3 â†’ 2.3
                const parts = code.split('_');
                if (parts.length >= 3) return `${parts[1]}.${parts[2]}`;
                return '';
            }

            function formatGMTitle(title) {
                if (!title.includes(' â€” ')) return title;
                const [main, rest] = title.split(' â€” ');
                return `${main}<br><span style="font-size:.72rem;color:var(--subtext);font-style:italic">${rest}</span>`;
            }

            // Highlight sidebar nav child based on current cycle type
            function highlightNavType() {
                const name = (currentCycleName || '').toLowerCase();
                let typeKey = '';
                if (name.includes('sustainability')) typeKey = 'qs-sustainability';
                else if (name.includes('qs') && name.includes('world')) typeKey = 'qs-wur';
                else if (name.includes('world')) typeKey = 'the-wur';
                else if (name.includes('impact')) typeKey = 'the-impact';
                else if (name.includes('greenmetric')) typeKey = 'greenmetric';

                document.querySelectorAll('.nav-child').forEach(a => {
                    const url = new URL(a.href, location.href);
                    if (url.searchParams.get('type') === typeKey) a.classList.add('active');
                });
            }

            function showAlert(title, msg) {
                document.getElementById('alertTitle').textContent = title;
                document.getElementById('alertMsg').textContent = msg;
                document.getElementById('alertConfirmBtn').onclick = () => closeModal('alertModal');
                document.getElementById('alertModal').classList.add('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }

            function closeModal(id) {
                document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = '';
            }

            let _reviewTaskId = null;

            function openReviewModal(q) {
                _reviewTaskId = q.task_id;
                document.getElementById('reviewComment').value = '';
                document.getElementById('reviewModalTitle').textContent = 'Evaluate Submission';
                document.getElementById('reviewModalSub').textContent = `"${q.title.slice(0, 80)}${q.title.length > 80 ? 'â€¦' : ''}"`;
                document.getElementById('reviewModal').classList.add('show');
                document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
            }

            async function submitReview(status) {
                const comment = document.getElementById('reviewComment').value.trim();
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/answers/${_reviewTaskId}/status`, {
                        method: 'PATCH',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ status, comment })
                    });
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data.success) {
                        closeModal('reviewModal');
                        const q = allQuestions.find(q => q.task_id === _reviewTaskId);
                        if (q) q.task_status = status;
                        if (isGreenMetric) {
                            renderSections(allQuestions.filter(q => q.gm_category === activeGMTab));
                        } else if (isTheImpact) {
                            renderSections(allQuestions.filter(q => q.theme === activeImpactTab));
                        } else {
                            renderSections();
                        }
                    } else {
                        showAlert('Error', data.error || 'Failed to update status');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    showAlert('Server Error', 'Something went wrong.');
                }
            }

            function openReviewById(questionId) {
                const q = allQuestions.find(x => x.id === questionId);
                if (q) openReviewModal(q);
            }

            Promise.all([loadCycleInfo(), loadDepartments(), loadQuestions()]).then(() => {
                if (isGreenMetric) {
                    document.querySelector('.def-panel').style.display = 'none';
                    renderSections(allQuestions.filter(q => q.gm_category === activeGMTab));
                } else if (isTheImpact) {
                    document.querySelector('.def-panel').style.display = 'none';
                    renderSections(allQuestions.filter(q => q.theme === activeImpactTab));
                } else {
                    renderSections();
                }

                // If opened via "Edit" button, start in edit mode
                if (editMode) {
                    const btn = document.getElementById('editModeBtn');
                    if (btn && !btn.disabled && !btn.classList.contains('active')) {
                        toggleEditMode();
                    }
                }
            });

    <script>
        const API_BASE = location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
            ? 'http://localhost:3002'
            : 'https://uob-rankings.onrender.com';

        const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
        const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
        if (!token || user.role !== 'admin') window.location.href = 'login.html';

        document.getElementById('userName').textContent = user.name || 'Admin';
        const initials = (user.name || 'Admin').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);
        document.getElementById('userAvatar').textContent = initials;

        function toggleSidebar() {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('collapsed');
        }

        function toggleCycles() {
            const el = document.getElementById('navCycles');
            const ar = document.getElementById('cyclesArrow');
            el.classList.toggle('open');
            ar.style.transform = el.classList.contains('open') ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)';
        }

        function logout() {
            fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/logout`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } }).catch(() => {});
            localStorage.clear(); 
            window.location.href = 'login.html';
        }

        // --- DEPARTMENT HELPERS ---
        const deptColors = {
            'IT & Digital Services': '#094FA3', 'Sustainability Office': '#16a34a',
            'Human Resources': '#f59e0b', 'Research & Graduate Studies': '#0891b2',
            'Finance & Accounts': '#8b5cf6', 'Quality Assurance': '#ec4899',
            'College of Science': '#f97316', 'Deanship of Student Affairs': '#64748b',
            'Registrar Office': '#dc2626', 'Deanship of Graduate Studies': '#094FA3',
            'Deanship of Admissions': '#B99B68'
        };
        function getDeptColor(name) { return deptColors[name] || '#6b7c9e'; }
        function getInitials(name) { return name.split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2); }
        function getProgColor(pct) {
            if (pct === 100) return '#16a34a';
            if (pct >= 60) return '#094FA3';
            if (pct >= 30) return '#f59e0b';
            return '#dc2626';
        }
        function getStatus(pct, submitted) {
            if (pct === 100) return { cls: 'pill-green', label: 'Complete' };
            if (pct >= 60) return { cls: 'pill-blue', label: 'On Track' };
            if (pct >= 1) return { cls: 'pill-amber', label: 'In Progress' };
            if (submitted === 0) return { cls: 'pill-red', label: 'Not Started' };
            return { cls: 'pill-gray', label: 'No Data' };
        }
        function getActionBtn(pct, deptName) {
            const safeName = deptName.replace(/'/g, "\\'");
            if (pct === 100) return `<button class="btn-done"><i class="fas fa-check"></i> Done</button>`;
            if (pct === 0) return `<button class="btn-urgent" onclick="sendReminder('${safeName}')"><i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"></i> Urgent</button>`;
            return `<button class="btn-remind" onclick="sendReminder('${safeName}')"><i class="fas fa-bell"></i> Remind</button>`;
        }
        function sendReminder(deptName) { alert(`Reminder sent to ${deptName}!`); }

        let progressData = [];

        // --- BULLETPROOF API CALLS ---
        async function loadCycles() {
            const sel = document.getElementById('cycleFilter');
            sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Loading cycles...</option>';
            
            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/cycles`, {
                    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
                });
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch cycles');
                const data = await res.json();
                
                // DEFENSIVE: Handle both direct arrays and wrapped objects { cycles: [...] }
                const cycles = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.cycles || data.data || []);
                
                if (cycles.length === 0) {
                    sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">No cycles available</option>';
                    renderEmptyTable('No ranking cycles found in the system.');
                    return;
                }

                // DEFENSIVE: Safely extract ID whether it's named 'id' or '_id'
                sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Select a Cycle --</option>' + 
                    cycles.map(c => `<option value="${c.id || c._id}">${c.name}</option>`).join('');
                
                // Auto-select the first cycle and explicitly pass its ID to loadProgress
                const firstCycleId = cycles[0].id || cycles[0]._id;
                sel.value = firstCycleId;
                loadProgress(firstCycleId);
                
            } catch (e) { 
                console.error('Error loading cycles:', e); 
                sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">Error loading cycles</option>';
                renderEmptyTable('Failed to connect to the server.');
            }
        }

        async function loadProgress(cycleId) {
            // Use the explicitly passed ID, or fall back to reading the DOM
            const activeCycleId = cycleId || document.getElementById('cycleFilter').value;
            
            if (!activeCycleId) {
                renderEmptyTable('Please select a ranking cycle to view progress.');
                return;
            }

            // Show loading state immediately
            document.getElementById('statDepts').textContent = '...';
            document.getElementById('statComplete').textContent = '...';
            document.getElementById('statInProgress').textContent = '...';
            document.getElementById('statNotStarted').textContent = '...';
            document.getElementById('progressTableBody').innerHTML = `
                <tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--text-secondary)">
                    <i class="fas fa-circle-notch fa-spin"></i> Loading data...
                </td></tr>`;

            try {
                const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/progress/${activeCycleId}`, {
                    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
                });
                if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${res.status}`);
                
                const data = await res.json();
                // DEFENSIVE: Handle both direct arrays and wrapped objects
                progressData = Array.isArray(data) ? data : (data.departments || data.progress || data.data || []);

                const total = progressData.length;
                const complete = progressData.filter(d => d.assigned > 0 && d.submitted === d.assigned).length;
                const inProgress = progressData.filter(d => d.submitted > 0 && d.submitted < d.assigned).length;
                const notStarted = progressData.filter(d => d.submitted === 0).length;

                document.getElementById('statDepts').textContent = total;
                document.getElementById('statComplete').textContent = complete;
                document.getElementById('statInProgress').textContent = inProgress;
                document.getElementById('statNotStarted').textContent = notStarted;

                const tbody = document.getElementById('progressTableBody');
                if (!progressData.length) {
                    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--text-secondary)">No departments assigned to this cycle yet.</td></tr>';
                    return;
                }
                
                // Batched DOM update
                tbody.innerHTML = progressData.map(d => {
                    const pct = d.assigned ? Math.round((d.submitted / d.assigned) * 100) : 0;
                    const color = getDeptColor(d.name);
                    const status = getStatus(pct, d.submitted);
                    return `<tr>
                        <td><div class="dept-cell"><div class="dept-init" style="background:${color}">${getInitials(d.name)}</div><div class="dept-name">${d.name}</div></div></td>
                        <td class="num-cell">${d.assigned}</td>
                        <td class="num-cell" style="color:var(--green);font-weight:700">${d.submitted}</td>
                        <td class="num-cell" style="color:var(--amber)">${d.pending || 0}</td>
                        <td class="num-cell" style="color:var(--supporting-red)">${d.overdue || 0}</td>
                        <td><div class="prog-wrap"><div class="prog-bar"><div class="prog-fill" style="width:${pct}%;background:${getProgColor(pct)}"></div></div><div class="prog-pct" style="color:${getProgColor(pct)}">${pct}%</div></div></td>
                        <td><span class="status-pill ${status.cls}">${status.label}</span></td>
                        <td><div class="action-cell">${getActionBtn(pct, d.name)}</div></td>
                    </tr>`;
                }).join('');
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('Error loading progress:', e);
                renderEmptyTable('Failed to load progress data. Please try again.');
            }
        }

        function renderEmptyTable(message) {
            ['statDepts', 'statComplete', 'statInProgress', 'statNotStarted'].forEach(id => {
                document.getElementById(id).textContent = '0';
            });
            document.getElementById('progressTableBody').innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="8" style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--text-secondary)">${message}</td></tr>`;
        }

        function exportCSV() {
            if (!progressData.length) { alert('No data to export.'); return; }
            const headers = ['Department', 'Assigned', 'Submitted', 'Pending', 'Overdue', 'Completion %', 'Status'];
            const rows = progressData.map(d => {
                const pct = d.assigned ? Math.round((d.submitted / d.assigned) * 100) : 0;
                const status = getStatus(pct, d.submitted).label;
                return [d.name, d.assigned, d.submitted, d.pending || 0, d.overdue || 0, pct + '%', status].join(',');
            });
            const csv = [headers.join(','), ...rows].join('\n');
            const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: 'text/csv' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            const cycleName = document.getElementById('cycleFilter').options[document.getElementById('cycleFilter').selectedIndex].text;
            a.download = `progress_${cycleName.replace(/\s+/g, '_')}_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.csv`;
            a.click();
        }

        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadCycles();
            // Open cycles menu by default for better UX
            document.getElementById('navCycles').classList.add('open');
            document.getElementById('cyclesArrow').style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const API_BASE = location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
? 'http://localhost:3002'
: 'https://uob-rankings.onrender.com';
const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
if (!token || user.role !== 'admin') window.location.href = 'login.html';
document.getElementById('adminName').textContent = user.name || 'Admin';
document.getElementById('adminAvatar').textContent = (user.name || 'AD').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);

let allTemplates = [];
let selectedTemplate = null;
let templateQuestions = [];
let editingQuestionId = null;

// â”€â”€ Sidebar â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function toggleSidebar() {
const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
}
if (localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true') {
document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
}
function logout() {
fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/logout`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } }).catch(() => {});
localStorage.clear();
window.location.href = 'login.html';
}

// â”€â”€ Load templates â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
async function loadTemplates() {
try {
const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/templates`, {
headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
});
allTemplates = await res.json();
renderTemplates();
} catch (e) {
console.error(e);
document.getElementById('templatesList').innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-state-icon">âš ï¸</div><div class="empty-state-title">Failed to load templates</div></div>';
}
}

function renderTemplates() {
const list = document.getElementById('templatesList');
if (!allTemplates.length) {
list.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state">
<div class="empty-state-icon">ðŸ“‹</div>
<div class="empty-state-title">No templates yet</div>
<div class="empty-state-sub">Click "+ New Template" to create your first question template</div>
</div>`;
return;
}
list.innerHTML = allTemplates.map(t => `
<div class="template-card ${selectedTemplate?.id === t.id ? 'active' : ''}" onclick="selectTemplate(${t.id})">
<div class="template-card-name">${t.name}</div>
<div class="template-card-meta">
${t.year ? `<span>Year: ${t.year}</span>` : ''}
<span class="template-card-count">${t.question_count || 0} Q</span>
</div>
</div>
`).join('');
}

// â”€â”€ Select template â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
async function selectTemplate(id) {
selectedTemplate = allTemplates.find(t => t.id === id);
renderTemplates();
document.getElementById('questionsPanelTitle').textContent = selectedTemplate.name;
document.getElementById('questionsPanelSub').textContent = `Template ID: ${selectedTemplate.id}${selectedTemplate.year ? ' Â· Year: ' + selectedTemplate.year : ''}`;
document.getElementById('addQuestionBtn').style.display = 'inline-flex';
await loadTemplateQuestions();
}

async function loadTemplateQuestions() {
const list = document.getElementById('questionsList');
list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-state-icon">â³</div><div class="empty-state-title">Loading questions...</div></div>';
try {
const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/templates/${selectedTemplate.id}/questions`, {
headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
});
templateQuestions = await res.json();
renderQuestions();
} catch (e) {
console.error(e);
list.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><div class="empty-state-icon">âš ï¸</div><div class="empty-state-title">Failed to load questions</div></div>';
}
}

function renderQuestions() {
const list = document.getElementById('questionsList');
if (!templateQuestions.length) {
list.innerHTML = `<div class="empty-state">
<div class="empty-state-icon">â“</div>
<div class="empty-state-title">No questions in this template</div>
<div class="empty-state-sub">Click "+ Add Question" to start building this template</div>
</div>`;
return;
}
list.innerHTML = templateQuestions.map(q => `
<div class="question-card">
<div class="question-card-top">
${q.code ? `<span class="question-code">${q.code}</span>` : ''}
<div class="question-title">${q.title}</div>
</div>
${q.description ? `<div style="font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text-secondary);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:.6rem">${q.description}</div>` : ''}
<div class="question-meta">
<span class="question-meta-item"><i class="fas fa-tag"></i> ${q.theme || 'General'}</span>
<span class="question-meta-item"><i class="fas fa-cube"></i> ${q.question_type}</span>
${q.gm_category ? `<span class="question-meta-item"><i class="fas fa-leaf"></i> ${q.gm_category}</span>` : ''}
${q.has_evidence ? `<span class="question-meta-item"><i class="fas fa-link"></i> Evidence required</span>` : ''}
</div>
<div class="question-actions">
<button class="btn-edit" onclick="openEditQuestionModal(${q.id})"><i class="fas fa-edit"></i> Edit</button>
<button class="btn-danger" onclick="deleteQuestion(${q.id})"><i class="fas fa-trash"></i> Delete</button>
</div>
</div>
`).join('');
}

// â”€â”€ Modal helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function openModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.add('show'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
function closeModal(id) { document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('show'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
function showAlert(title, msg) {
document.getElementById('alertTitle').textContent = title;
document.getElementById('alertMsg').textContent = msg;
openModal('alertModal');
}

// â”€â”€ Add Template â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function openAddTemplateModal() {
document.getElementById('templateForm').reset();
openModal('templateModal');
}

async function handleTemplateSubmit(event) {
event.preventDefault();
const btn = document.getElementById('saveTemplateBtn');
btn.disabled = true;
btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Creating...';
try {
const payload = {
name: document.getElementById('tName').value.trim(),
year: document.getElementById('tYear').value ? parseInt(document.getElementById('tYear').value) : null,
description: document.getElementById('tDesc').value.trim(),
is_template: true
};
const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/cycles`, {
method: 'POST',
headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
body: JSON.stringify(payload)
});
const data = await res.json();
if (data.success) {
closeModal('templateModal');
await loadTemplates();
// Auto-select the new template
const newTemplate = allTemplates.find(t => t.id === data.id);
if (newTemplate) selectTemplate(newTemplate.id);
} else {
showAlert('Error', data.error || 'Failed to create template');
}
} catch (e) {
showAlert('Server Error', 'Make sure the server is running.');
} finally {
btn.disabled = false;
btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-save"></i> Create Template';
}
}

// â”€â”€ Add/Edit Question â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
function openAddQuestionModal() {
editingQuestionId = null;
document.getElementById('questionModalTitle').textContent = 'Add Question';
document.getElementById('saveBtnText').textContent = 'Save Question';
document.getElementById('questionForm').reset();
document.getElementById('qTheme').value = 'General';
openModal('questionModal');
}

function openEditQuestionModal(id) {
const q = templateQuestions.find(x => x.id === id);
if (!q) return;
editingQuestionId = id;
document.getElementById('questionModalTitle').textContent = 'Edit Question';
document.getElementById('saveBtnText').textContent = 'Update Question';
document.getElementById('qCode').value = q.code || '';
document.getElementById('qTitle').value = q.title || '';
document.getElementById('qDesc').value = q.description || '';
document.getElementById('qType').value = q.question_type || '';
document.getElementById('qTheme').value = q.theme || 'General';
document.getElementById('qGmCategory').value = q.gm_category || '';
document.getElementById('qHasEvidence').checked = q.has_evidence === 1;
openModal('questionModal');
}

async function handleQuestionSubmit(event) {
event.preventDefault();
if (!selectedTemplate) { showAlert('Error', 'No template selected'); return; }
const btn = document.getElementById('saveQuestionBtn');
btn.disabled = true;
const originalHtml = btn.innerHTML;
btn.innerHTML = '<i class="fas fa-spinner fa-spin"></i> Saving...';
try {
const payload = {
code: document.getElementById('qCode').value.trim(),
title: document.getElementById('qTitle').value.trim(),
description: document.getElementById('qDesc').value.trim(),
question_type: document.getElementById('qType').value,
theme: document.getElementById('qTheme').value,
gm_category: document.getElementById('qGmCategory').value || null,
has_evidence: document.getElementById('qHasEvidence').checked ? 1 : 0
};
const url = editingQuestionId
? `${API_BASE}/api/admin/questions/${editingQuestionId}`
: `${API_BASE}/api/admin/templates/${selectedTemplate.id}/questions`;
const method = editingQuestionId ? 'PATCH' : 'POST';
const res = await fetch(url, {
method,
headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
body: JSON.stringify(payload)
});
const data = await res.json();
if (data.success) {
closeModal('questionModal');
await loadTemplateQuestions();
await loadTemplates(); // refresh question counts
} else {
showAlert('Error', data.error || 'Failed to save question');
}
} catch (e) {
showAlert('Server Error', 'Make sure the server is running.');
} finally {
btn.disabled = false;
btn.innerHTML = originalHtml;
}
}

// â”€â”€ Delete Question â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
async function deleteQuestion(id) {
if (!confirm('Are you sure you want to delete this question? This cannot be undone.')) return;
try {
const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/questions/${id}`, {
method: 'DELETE',
headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
});
const data = await res.json();
if (data.success) {
await loadTemplateQuestions();
await loadTemplates();
} else {
showAlert('Error', data.error || 'Failed to delete question');
}
} catch (e) {
showAlert('Server Error', 'Make sure the server is running.');
}
}

// â”€â”€ Init â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
loadTemplates();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        const API_BASE = location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
            ? 'http://localhost:3002'
            : 'https://uob-rankings.onrender.com';

        const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
        const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
        if (!token || user.role !== 'admin') window.location.href = 'login.html';

        document.getElementById('userName').textContent = user.name || 'Admin';
        const initials = (user.name || 'Admin').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);
        document.getElementById('userAvatar').textContent = initials;

        let currentCycle = 'all';

        function toggleSidebar() {
            const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
            sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
            localStorage.setItem('sidebarCollapsed', sidebar.classList.contains('collapsed'));
        }

        // Restore sidebar state
        const sidebarCollapsed = localStorage.getItem('sidebarCollapsed') === 'true';
        if (sidebarCollapsed) {
            document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.add('collapsed');
        }

        function toggleCycles() {
            const el = document.getElementById('navCycles');
            const arrow = document.getElementById('cyclesArrow');
            el.classList.toggle('open');
            arrow.style.transform = el.classList.contains('open') ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)';
        }

        function logout() {
            fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/logout`, {
                method: 'POST',
                headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
            }).catch(() => {});
            localStorage.clear();
            window.location.href = 'login.html';
        }

        function getDeptColor(name) {
            const map = {
                'IT & Digital Services': '#4B95FA',
                'Sustainability Office': '#16a34a',
                'Human Resources': '#f59e0b',
                'Research & Graduate Studies': '#094FA3',
                'Finance & Accounts': '#8b5cf6',
                'Quality Assurance': '#ec4899',
                'College of Science': '#f97316',
                'Deanship of Student Affairs': '#64748b',
                'Registrar Office': '#dc2626'
            };
            return map[name] || '#6b7c9e';
        }
        
        function getInitials(name) {
            return name.split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);
        }
        
        function getStatusPill(pct) {
            if (pct === 100) return '<span class="status-pill pill-green"><i class="fas fa-check"></i> Complete</span>';
            if (pct >= 60) return '<span class="status-pill pill-blue">On Track</span>';
            if (pct >= 30) return '<span class="status-pill pill-amber">In Progress</span>';
            if (pct > 0) return '<span class="status-pill pill-red">Overdue</span>';
            return '<span class="status-pill pill-red">Not Started</span>';
        }

        function getTimeAgo(dateString) {
            if (!dateString) return 'Recently';
            const date = new Date(dateString);
            const now = new Date();
            const seconds = Math.floor((now - date) / 1000);
            if (seconds < 60) return 'Just now';
            const minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
            if (minutes < 60) return minutes + 'm ago';
            const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
            if (hours < 24) return hours + 'h ago';
            const days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
            return days + 'd ago';
        }

        async function loadDashboard() {
            try {
                const url = currentCycle === 'all' 
                    ? `${API_BASE}/api/admin/dashboard` 
                    : `${API_BASE}/api/admin/dashboard?cycle_id=${currentCycle}`;
                    
                const res = await fetch(url, {
                    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
                });
                const data = await res.json();

                document.getElementById('statTotal').textContent = data.total || 0;
                document.getElementById('statSubmitted').textContent = data.submitted || 0;
                document.getElementById('statPending').textContent = data.pending || 0;
                document.getElementById('statOverdue').textContent = data.overdue || 0;
                const pct = data.total ? Math.round((data.submitted / data.total) * 100) : 0;
                document.getElementById('statPct').textContent = pct + '% completion';

                const tbody = document.getElementById('deptTableBody');
                if (data.departments && data.departments.length > 0) {
                    tbody.innerHTML = data.departments.map(d => {
                        const deptPct = d.total ? Math.round((d.submitted / d.total) * 100) : 0;
                        const color = getDeptColor(d.name);
                        return `<tr>
                            <td>
                                <div class="dept-name-cell">
                                    <div class="dept-init" style="background:${color}">${getInitials(d.name)}</div>
                                    <div class="dept-name">${d.name}</div>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                            <td>
                                <div class="prog-wrap">
                                    <div class="prog-bar"><div class="prog-fill" style="width:${deptPct}%"></div></div>
                                    <div class="prog-pct">${deptPct}%</div>
                                </div>
                            </td>
                            <td>${getStatusPill(deptPct)}</td>
                        </tr>`;
                    }).join('');
                } else {
                    tbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="3" style="text-align:center;color:var(--text-secondary);padding:1.5rem">No data</td></tr>';
                }

                const activityList = document.getElementById('activityList');
                if (data.activities && data.activities.length > 0) {
                    activityList.innerHTML = data.activities.slice(0, 5).map(act => {
                        const iconClass = act.status === 'approved' ? 'fa-check' : 'fa-file';
                        const iconColor = act.status === 'approved' ? '#16a34a' : '#f59e0b';
                        return `<div class="activity-item">
                            <div class="act-icon" style="color:${iconColor}">
                                <i class="fas ${iconClass}"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="act-content">
                                <div class="act-text"><strong>${act.dept_name}</strong> ${act.status === 'approved' ? 'approved' : 'submitted'} "${act.question_title}"</div>
                                <div class="act-time">${getTimeAgo(act.submitted_at)}</div>
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                    }).join('');
                } else {
                    activityList.innerHTML = '<div class="activity-item"><div class="act-text" style="color:var(--text-secondary);text-align:center;width:100%">No recent activity</div></div>';
                }

            } catch (err) {
                console.error('Dashboard load error:', err);
            }
        }

        // Initialize
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            loadDashboard();
            // Open cycles menu by default for consistency with other pages
            document.getElementById('navCycles').classList.add('open');
            document.getElementById('cyclesArrow').style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    const API_BASE = location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
      ? 'http://localhost:3002'
      : 'https://uob-rankings.onrender.com';

    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
    if (!token) window.location.href = 'login.html';

    // Display user info
    document.getElementById('userName').textContent = user.name || 'User';
    document.querySelector('.user-role').textContent = user.role === 'admin' ? 'Administrator' : 'Department User';
    document.getElementById('welcomeName').textContent = (user.name || 'User') + ' ðŸ‘‹';
    const initials = (user.name || 'U').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);
    document.getElementById('userAvatar').textContent = initials;

    // Sidebar toggle
    function toggleSidebar() {
      const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
        sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
      } else {
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
      }
    }

    // Cycles dropdown toggle
    function toggleCycles() {
      const el = document.getElementById('navCycles');
      const ar = document.getElementById('cyclesArrow');
      el.classList.toggle('open');
      ar.style.transform = el.classList.contains('open') ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)';
    }

    // Logout
    document.getElementById('logoutBtn').addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/logout`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } });
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('user');
      window.location.href = 'login.html';
    });

    // --- DATA LOADING LOGIC (UNCHANGED) ---
    async function loadDashboardData() {
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/questions/my-rankings`, {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        const rankings = await res.json();
        
        if (!Array.isArray(rankings) || rankings.length === 0) {
          document.getElementById('formsList').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--text-secondary)">No forms assigned yet.</div>';
          document.getElementById('deadlinesList').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--text-secondary)">No upcoming deadlines.</div>';
          return;
        }

        let totalQ = 0, submittedQ = 0, urgentCount = 0;
        const chartData = [];
        const formsHtml = [];
        const deadlinesHtml = [];
        const colors = ['var(--primary-blue)', 'var(--primary-gold)', 'var(--supporting-red)', 'var(--green)', 'var(--bright-blue)'];

        rankings.forEach((r, index) => {
          const assigned = r.assigned || 0;
          const submitted = r.submitted || 0;
          const pct = assigned ? Math.round((submitted / assigned) * 100) : 0;
          totalQ += assigned;
          submittedQ += submitted;
          if (r.outstanding > 0) urgentCount++;

          chartData.push({ name: r.name.split(' ')[0], pct: pct, color: colors[index % colors.length] });

          formsHtml.push(`
            <div class="form-row" onclick="window.location.href='form.html?cycle=${r.id}'">
              <div class="form-icon"><i class="fas fa-file-alt"></i></div>
              <div class="form-info">
                <div class="form-name">${r.name}</div>
                <div class="progress-bar-wrap">
                  <div class="progress-bar" style="width:${pct}%;background:${colors[index % colors.length]}"></div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div style="font-size:.8rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-secondary)">${pct}%</div>
            </div>
          `);

          if (r.outstanding > 0 && r.next_due) {
            const date = new Date(r.next_due);
            const day = date.getDate();
            const mon = date.toLocaleString('en-GB', { month: 'short' });
            const isUrgent = r.outstanding > 2;
            
            deadlinesHtml.push(`
              <div class="deadline-item">
                <div class="deadline-date">
                  <div class="deadline-day">${day}</div>
                  <div class="deadline-mon">${mon}</div>
                </div>
                <div class="deadline-info">
                  <div class="deadline-title">${r.name}</div>
                  <div class="deadline-sub">Data submission deadline</div>
                  <div class="deadline-tags" style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem">
                    <span class="tag-ranking">${r.name.split(' ')[0]} ${r.name.split(' ')[1] || ''}</span>
                    <span class="urgency ${isUrgent ? 'urg-urgent' : 'urg-soon'}">${isUrgent ? 'Urgent' : 'Soon'}</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            `);
          }
        });

        // Update Stats
        document.getElementById('statTotal').textContent = totalQ;
        document.getElementById('statProgress').textContent = totalQ - submittedQ;
        document.getElementById('statSubmitted').textContent = submittedQ;
        document.getElementById('statUrgent').textContent = urgentCount;

        // Update Chart
        document.getElementById('chartBars').innerHTML = chartData.map(d => `
          <div class="bar-group">
            <span class="bar-pct">${d.pct}%</span>
            <div class="bar" style="height:calc(200px * ${d.pct / 100});background:${d.color}"></div>
            <span class="bar-name">${d.name}</span>
          </div>
        `).join('');

        // Update Lists
        document.getElementById('formsList').innerHTML = formsHtml.join('') || '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--text-secondary)">No forms found.</div>';
        document.getElementById('deadlinesList').innerHTML = deadlinesHtml.join('') || '<div style="text-align:center;padding:2rem;color:var(--text-secondary)">No upcoming deadlines. Great job!</div>';

      } catch (err) {
        console.error('Failed to load dashboard data:', err);
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      loadDashboardData();
      // Open cycles menu by default
      document.getElementById('navCycles').classList.add('open');
      document.getElementById('cyclesArrow').style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    const API_BASE = location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
      ? 'http://localhost:3002'
      : 'https://uob-rankings.onrender.com';

    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
    
    if (!token) window.location.href = 'login.html';

    // Display user info in header
    document.getElementById('userName').textContent = user.name || 'Admin';
    document.querySelector('.user-role').textContent = user.role === 'admin' ? 'Administrator' : 'Department User';
    const initials = (user.name || 'Admin').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);
    document.getElementById('userAvatar').textContent = initials;

    // Sidebar toggle
    function toggleSidebar() {
      document.getElementById('sidebar').classList.toggle('collapsed');
    }

    // Cycles dropdown toggle
    function toggleCycles() {
      const el = document.getElementById('navCycles');
      const ar = document.getElementById('cyclesArrow');
      el.classList.toggle('open');
      ar.style.transform = el.classList.contains('open') ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)';
    }

    // Modal helpers
    function openModal(id) {
      document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
    }

    function closeModal(id) {
      document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active');
    }

    // Close modal on outside click
    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-overlay').forEach(overlay => {
      overlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (e.target === overlay) {
          overlay.classList.remove('active');
        }
      });
    });

    // Toast notification helper
    function showToast(message, type = 'success') {
      const toast = document.getElementById('toast');
      const toastMessage = document.getElementById('toastMessage');
      const toastIcon = document.getElementById('toastIcon');
      
      toastMessage.textContent = message;
      
      if (type === 'error') {
        toast.classList.add('error');
        toastIcon.textContent = 'âš ï¸';
      } else {
        toast.classList.remove('error');
        toastIcon.textContent = 'âœ…';
      }
      
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        toast.classList.add('show');
      });
      
      setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove('show');
      }, 3500);
    }

    // Load data
    async function loadData() {
      try {
        const uRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/users`, { 
          headers: {'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`}
        });
        const users = await uRes.json();
        
        const tbody = document.getElementById('userTable');
        if (!users || users.length === 0) {
          tbody.innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align: center; padding: 3rem; color: var(--text-secondary);">No users found.</td></tr>`;
        } else {
          tbody.innerHTML = users.map(u => {
            const roleBadge = u.role === 'admin' 
              ? `<span class="status-pill pill-blue">Admin</span>` 
              : `<span class="status-pill pill-green">Department</span>`;
            
            const userInitials = (u.name || 'U').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);
              
            return `
              <tr>
                <td>
                  <div class="dept-cell">
                    <div class="dept-init" style="background: var(--primary-blue)">${userInitials}</div>
                    <div class="dept-name">${u.name}</div>
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td>${u.email}</td>
                <td>${u.department_name || '<span style="color:var(--text-light)">N/A</span>'}</td>
                <td>${roleBadge}</td>
              </tr>
            `;
          }).join('');
        }

        const dRes = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/departments`, { 
          headers: {'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`}
        });
        const depts = await dRes.json();
        const select = document.getElementById('deptSelect');
        select.innerHTML = '<option value="">-- Select Department --</option>' + 
          (depts || []).map(d => `<option value="${d.id}">${d.name}</option>`).join('');
          
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        document.getElementById('userTable').innerHTML = `<tr><td colspan="4" style="text-align: center; padding: 3rem; color: var(--supporting-red);">Failed to load data. Please try again.</td></tr>`;
      }
    }

    // Form submissions
    async function submitUser(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const formData = new FormData(e.target);
      const data = Object.fromEntries(formData);
      
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/add-user`, { 
          method: 'POST', 
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json', 
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`
          }, 
          body: JSON.stringify(data)
        });
        
        if (res.ok) {
          closeModal('userModal');
          e.target.reset();
          loadData();
          showToast('User created successfully!', 'success');
        } else {
          showToast('Failed to create user. Please check the details.', 'error');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        showToast('An error occurred while creating the user.', 'error');
      }
    }

    async function submitDept(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      const formData = new FormData(e.target);
      const data = Object.fromEntries(formData);
      
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/admin/add-department`, { 
          method: 'POST', 
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json', 
            'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`
          }, 
          body: JSON.stringify(data)
        });
        
        if (res.ok) {
          closeModal('deptModal');
          e.target.reset();
          loadData();
          showToast('Department created successfully!', 'success');
        } else {
          showToast('Failed to create department. Please try again.', 'error');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(err);
        showToast('An error occurred while creating the department.', 'error');
      }
    }

    // Logout
    document.getElementById('logoutBtn').addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/logout`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
      }
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('user');
      window.location.href = 'login.html';
    });

    // Initialize
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      loadData();
      // Open cycles menu by default for consistency with progress page
      document.getElementById('navCycles').classList.add('open');
      document.getElementById('cyclesArrow').style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

  <script>
    const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
    const code = params.get('code') || '404';
    const errCodeEl = document.getElementById('errCode');
    const errTitleEl = document.getElementById('errTitle');
    const errMsgEl = document.getElementById('errMsg');
    
    errCodeEl.textContent = code;
    if (code === '500') {
      errTitleEl.textContent = 'Server Error';
      errMsgEl.textContent = 'Something went wrong on our end. Please try again later or contact the IT department if the issue persists.';
    } else if (code === '403' || code === '401') {
      errTitleEl.textContent = 'Access Denied';
      errMsgEl.textContent = 'You do not have permission to view this page. Please log in with the appropriate credentials.';
    } else {
      errTitleEl.textContent = 'Page Not Found';
      errMsgEl.textContent = 'We couldn\'t find the page you were looking for. Please check the URL and try again.';
    }
  </script>

===== C:\Users\User\UOB-Rankings\errorHandling.js =====
const path = require('path');
const notFoundHandler = (req, res, next) => res.status(404).sendFile(path.join(__dirname, 'error.html'));
const serverErrorHandler = (err, req, res, next) => {
    console.error(err.stack);
    res.status(500).sendFile(path.join(__dirname, 'error.html'));
};
module.exports = { notFoundHandler, serverErrorHandler };
