        <script>
            const API_BASE = location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
                ? 'http://localhost:3002'
                : 'https://uob-rankings.onrender.com';

            function markDirty() { } // no-op in dept form

            const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
            const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
            if (!token) window.location.href = 'login.html';

            document.getElementById('userName').textContent = user.name || 'User';
            document.getElementById('userAvatar').textContent = (user.name || 'U').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);

            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const cycleId = params.get('cycle');
            if (!cycleId) window.location.href = 'ranking-forms.html';

            const THE_WUR_SUBJECTS = [
                'Arts and Humanities', 'Clinical and Health', 'Engineering and Technology',
                'Computer Science', 'Life Sciences', 'Physical Sciences', 'Social Sciences',
                'Business and Economics', 'Psychology', 'Law', 'Education'
            ];

            let isTheWur = false;
            let isTheImpact = false;
            let isGreenMetric = false;
            let allQuestions = [];
            let activeGMTab = 'SI';
            let activeImpactTab = 'SDG3: Good Health and Wellbeing';

            function isGridQuestion(q) {
                const items = q.items || [];
                return items.length === 4 &&
                    items[0]?.label === 'Full Time' &&
                    items[1]?.label === 'Part Time';
            }

            function switchTab(tab, type) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.def-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                tab.classList.add('active');
                if (type === 'hist') {
                    const taskId = window._selectedTaskId;
                    if (!taskId) { document.getElementById('defBody').innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--subtext)">No question selected.</p>'; return; }
                    document.getElementById('defBody').innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--subtext)">Loading history...</p>';
                    fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/submissions/history-all/${taskId}`, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } })
                        .then(r => r.json()).then(rows => {
                            if (!rows.length) { document.getElementById('defBody').innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--subtext)">No previous submissions recorded.</p>'; return; }
                            document.getElementById('defBody').innerHTML = rows.map(h => {
                                const date = h.changed_at ? new Date(h.changed_at).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }) : 'â€”';
                                let val = h.answer_text || (h.answer_number !== null ? String(h.answer_number) : 'â€”');
                                try {
                                    const parsed = JSON.parse(val);
                                    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') {
                                        if ('ft' in parsed) {
                                            val = `<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:.3rem .8rem;margin-top:.2rem">
                                                <div><span style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--subtext)">Full Time</span><div style="font-weight:600">${parsed.ft}</div></div>
                                                <div><span style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--subtext)">Part Time</span><div style="font-weight:600">${parsed.pt}</div></div>
                                                <div><span style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--subtext)">HC</span><div style="font-weight:600">${parsed.hc}</div></div>
                                                <div><span style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--subtext)">FTE</span><div style="font-weight:600">${parsed.fte}</div></div>
                                            </div>`;
                                        } else {
                                            const q = (window.questions || []).find(q =>
                                                q.title === document.getElementById('defTitle').textContent
                                            );
                                            const items = q?.items || [];
                                            const lines = Object.entries(parsed).map(([idx, v]) => {
                                                const item = items[parseInt(idx)];
                                                const label = item ? item.label.split(' â€” ').pop() : `Field ${parseInt(idx) + 1}`;
                                                if (item?.answer_type === 'checkbox') {
                                                    const ticked = v === 'yes';
                                                    return `<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;margin:.2rem 0">
                                                        <span style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:3px;border:1.5px solid ${ticked ? 'var(--teal)' : '#d1d5db'};background:${ticked ? 'var(--teal)' : '#fff'};flex-shrink:0;font-size:.65rem;color:#fff">${ticked ? 'âœ“' : ''}</span>
                                                        <span style="font-size:.8rem;color:${ticked ? 'var(--text)' : 'var(--subtext)'}">${label}</span>
                                                    </div>`;
                                                }
                                                const isEmpty = !v || v === '' || v === '<p><br></p>' || v === '<p></p>';
                                                if (isEmpty && item?.answer_type !== 'url' && item?.answer_type !== 'richtext' && item?.answer_type !== 'text') return '';
                                                return `<div style="margin:.25rem 0">
                                                    <div style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--subtext);margin-bottom:.1rem">${label}</div>
                                                    <div style="font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text);word-break:break-word">
                                                        ${isEmpty ? '<span style="color:var(--subtext);font-style:italic">Not provided</span>' : v}
                                                    </div>
                                                </div>`;
                                            }).filter(Boolean).join('');
                                            val = lines || 'â€”';
                                        }
                                    }
                                } catch (e) { }
                                return `<div style="border-bottom:1px solid #f0f2f8;padding:.65rem 0">
                                    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:.25rem">
                                        <span style="font-size:.7rem;font-weight:700;background:#eef2ff;color:#3730a3;padding:.15rem .45rem;border-radius:4px">${h.year || ''}</span>
                                        <span style="font-size:.7rem;color:var(--subtext)">${date}</span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div style="font-size:.72rem;color:var(--subtext);margin-bottom:.2rem">${h.changed_by_name || 'Unknown'}</div>
                                    <div style="font-size:.8rem;color:var(--text);line-height:1.55">${val}</div>
                                </div>`;
                            }).join('');
                        }).catch(() => { document.getElementById('defBody').innerHTML = '<p style="color:var(--subtext)">Failed to load history.</p>'; });
                }
            }

            let currentCycleName = '';

            function getTableHeaderColor() {
                const name = (currentCycleName || '').toLowerCase();
                if (name.includes('qs sustainability')) return { bg: '#e8f5e9', text: '#2e7d32', border: '#a5d6a7' };
                if (name.includes('qs world university rankings')) return { bg: '#fef9e7', text: '#7a6000', border: '#f0d060' };
                if (name.includes('the world university rankings')) return { bg: '#f3e5f5', text: '#6a1b9a', border: '#ce93d8' };
                if (name.includes('the impact')) return { bg: '#fff7ed', text: '#c2410c', border: '#c2410c' };
                if (name.includes('greenmetric')) return { bg: '#e0f2f1', text: '#00695c', border: '#80cbc4' };
            }

            function selectRow(row) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.q-row').forEach(r => r.classList.remove('selected'));
                row.classList.add('selected');
                const taskId = row.dataset.taskid ? parseInt(row.dataset.taskid) : null;
                const title = row.dataset.title || '';
                const desc = row.dataset.desc || '';
                window._selectedTaskId = taskId || null;
                window._selectedQuestion = (window.questions || allQuestions || []).find(q => q.task_id === taskId);
                document.getElementById('defTitle').textContent = title;
                document.getElementById('defBody').innerHTML = `<p>${desc || 'No definition available.'}</p>`;
                document.querySelectorAll('.def-tab').forEach((t, i) => t.classList.toggle('active', i === 0));
            }

            function getStatusDot(status) {
                if (status === 'submitted') return '<span class="status-dot submitted" title="Submitted"></span>';
                if (status === 'accepted') return '<span class="status-dot accepted" title="Accepted"></span>';
                if (status === 'rejected') return '<span class="status-dot rejected" title="Rejected"></span>';
                if (status === 'queried') return '<span class="status-dot queried" title="Queried"></span>';
                if (status === 'pending') return '<span class="status-dot pending" title="Pending"></span>';
                return '<span class="status-dot" title="No Status"></span>';
            }

            function formatDate(d) {
                if (!d) return 'â€”';
                try { const dt = new Date(d); if (isNaN(dt)) return 'â€”'; return dt.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }); } catch (e) { return 'â€”'; }
            }

            function toggleSec(id) {
                const b = document.getElementById('body_' + id);
                const t = document.getElementById('tog_' + id);
                const open = b.style.display !== 'none';
                b.style.display = open ? 'none' : '';
                t.textContent = open ? 'â–¼' : 'â–²';
            }

            function calcEq(taskId) {
                const ft = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_0`)?.value) || 0;
                const pt = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_1`)?.value) || 0;
                const hcEl = document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_2`);
                const fteEl = document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_3`);
                if (hcEl) hcEl.value = ft + pt;
                if (fteEl) fteEl.value = Math.round(ft + (pt / 3));
            }

            function calcEmployment(taskId) {
                const totalRespondents = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_1`)?.value) || 0;
                const employed = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_2`)?.value) || 0;
                const unemployed = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_3`)?.value) || 0;
                const ftStudy = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_4`)?.value) || 0;
                const unavail = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_5`)?.value) || 0;
                const pctEl = document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_6`);
                const qsRateEl = document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_7`);
                if (totalRespondents > 0) {
                    const pct = ((employed + unemployed + ftStudy + unavail) / totalRespondents * 100).toFixed(1);
                    const qsRate = (employed / (employed + unemployed) * 100).toFixed(1);
                    if (pctEl) pctEl.value = pct;
                    if (qsRateEl) qsRateEl.value = qsRate;
                }
            }

            function initQuillEditors() {
                document.querySelectorAll('[id^="quill_container_"]').forEach(container => {
                    const itemId = container.id.replace('quill_container_', '');
                    const toolbarId = 'quill_toolbar_' + itemId;
                    const editorEl = document.getElementById(itemId);
                    if (!editorEl || editorEl._quill) return;
                    const q = window.questions?.find(q => (q.items || []).some((_, i) => `item_${q.task_id}_${i}` === itemId));
                    const locked = q ? (q.task_status && q.task_status !== 'pending') : false;
                    const quill = new Quill(editorEl, { modules: { toolbar: '#' + toolbarId }, theme: 'snow', readOnly: locked });
                    if (q) {
                        const itemIndex = parseInt(itemId.split('_').pop());
                        let existingVal = '';
                        if (q.answer_text) {
                            try {
                                const parsed = JSON.parse(q.answer_text);
                                if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') existingVal = parsed[itemIndex] ?? parsed[String(itemIndex)] ?? '';
                            } catch (e) { existingVal = q.answer_text; }
                        }
                        if (existingVal) quill.root.innerHTML = existingVal;
                    }
                    quill.on('text-change', () => {
                        const wcEl = document.getElementById('wc_' + itemId);
                        if (wcEl) wcEl.textContent = `${quill.getText().trim().split(/\s+/).filter(w => w.length > 0).length} words inserted`;
                    });
                    editorEl._quill = quill;
                });
            }

            function buildInput(q, locked = false) {
                const taskId = q.task_id || q.id;
                const dis = locked ? 'disabled' : '';
                const ro = locked ? 'readonly' : '';
                const ls = locked ? 'background:#f0f2f7;color:var(--subtext)' : '';
                const items = q.items || [];

                if (items.length > 0) {
                    let savedItems = {};
                    if (q.answer_text) {
                        try {
                            const parsed = JSON.parse(q.answer_text);
                            if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !('ft' in parsed)) savedItems = parsed;
                        } catch (e) { if (items.length === 1) savedItems = { 0: q.answer_text }; }
                    }
                    if (items.length === 1 && items[0].answer_type === 'number' && q.answer_number != null && !savedItems[0])
                        savedItems = { 0: String(q.answer_number) };

                    let html = '';
                    let i = 0;
                    while (i < items.length) {
                        const item = items[i];
                        const itemId = `item_${taskId}_${i}`;
                        const existingVal = savedItems[i] ?? savedItems[String(i)] ?? '';

                        if (item.answer_type === 'checkbox' && item.label.includes(' â€” ')) {
                            const [groupLabel] = item.label.split(' â€” ');
                            const groupItems = [];
                            let j = i;
                            while (j < items.length && items[j].answer_type === 'checkbox' && items[j].label.startsWith(groupLabel + ' â€” ')) {
                                groupItems.push({ item: items[j], idx: j }); j++;
                            }
                            if (groupItems.length > 1) {
                                if (!isGreenMetric) {
                                    html += `<div class="evidence-label" style="margin-top:1.5rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--text)">${groupLabel}</div>`;
                                }
                                groupItems.forEach(({ item: gi, idx }) => {
                                    const gId = `item_${taskId}_${idx}`;
                                    const isChecked = (savedItems[idx] === 'yes' || savedItems[idx] === true) ? 'checked' : '';
                                    html += `<label class="check-item" style="margin-top:.25rem"><input type="checkbox" id="${gId}" ${isChecked} ${dis}> ${gi.label.split(' â€” ')[1]}</label>`;
                                });
                                i = j; continue;
                            }
                        }

                        switch (item.answer_type) {
                            case 'checkbox': {
                                const isChecked = (existingVal === 'yes' || existingVal === true) ? 'checked' : '';
                                html += `<label class="check-item" style="margin-top:${i === 0 ? '.35rem' : '.9rem'};${i > 0 ? 'padding-top:.7rem;border-top:1px solid #f0f2f8;' : ''}">
                                    <input type="checkbox" id="${itemId}" ${isChecked} ${dis}> ${item.label}
                                </label>`; break;
                            }
                            case 'radio': {
                                html += `<label class="check-item" style="margin-top:${i === 0 ? '.35rem' : '.25rem'}">
                                    <input type="radio" name="radio_${taskId}" data-itemidx="${i}" 
                                        value="${item.label}" ${existingVal === item.label ? 'checked' : ''} ${dis}> 
                                    ${item.label.includes(' â€” ') ? item.label.split(' â€” ')[1] : item.label}
                                </label>`; break;
                            }
                            case 'url':
                                html += `<div class="evidence-label" style="margin-top:.8rem">${item.label}</div>
                                    <div class="url-wrap">
                                        <input class="url-input" type="url" id="${itemId}" value="${existingVal}" placeholder="https://..." ${ro} style="${ls}"/>
                                </div>`; break;
                            case 'number':
                                html += `<div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem">
                                    ${isGreenMetric ? '' : `<div class="evidence-label">${item.label}</div>`}
                                    <input class="txt-input" type="number" id="${itemId}" data-itemidx="${i}" value="${existingVal}" 
                                    placeholder="â€”" style="${ls}" ${ro}
                                    oninput="calcEmployment(${taskId})"/>
                                </div>`;
                                break;
                            case 'richtext':
                            case 'text':
                                html += `<div class="evidence-label" style="margin-top:1rem">${item.label}</div>
                                <div id="quill_container_${itemId}" style="margin-top:.3rem">
                                    <div id="quill_toolbar_${itemId}">
                                        <span class="ql-formats"><button class="ql-bold"></button><button class="ql-italic"></button><button class="ql-underline"></button><button class="ql-strike"></button><button class="ql-script" value="super"></button><button class="ql-script" value="sub"></button></span>
                                        <span class="ql-formats"><button class="ql-list" value="ordered"></button><button class="ql-list" value="bullet"></button></span>
                                        <span class="ql-formats"><button class="ql-link"></button><button class="ql-clean"></button></span>
                                    </div>
                                    <div id="${itemId}" style="min-height:80px;font-size:.78rem;font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif"></div>
                                </div>
                                ${item.max_words ? `<div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.71rem;color:var(--subtext);margin-top:.2rem"><span id="wc_${itemId}">0 words inserted</span><span>Maximum ${item.max_words} words</span></div>` : ''}`; break;
                            case 'select': {
                                const opts = (item.options || '').split(',').map(o => o.trim());
                                html += `<div class="evidence-label" style="margin-top:1rem">${item.label}</div>
                                <select class="txt-input" id="${itemId}" ${dis} style="${ls};cursor:pointer">
                                    <option value="">â€” Select â€”</option>
                                    ${opts.map(o => `<option value="${o}" ${existingVal === o ? 'selected' : ''}>${o}</option>`).join('')}
                                </select>`; break;
                            }
                            case 'calculated':
                                html += `<div class="evidence-label" style="margin-top:1rem">${item.label}</div>
                                <input class="txt-input" type="number" id="${itemId}" placeholder="Auto-calculated" readonly style="background:#f0f2f7;color:var(--subtext)"/>`; break;
                            default:
                                html += `<div class="evidence-label" style="margin-top:1.5rem">${item.label}</div>
                                <input class="txt-input" type="text" id="${itemId}" value="${existingVal}" placeholder="Enter answer" ${ro} style="${ls}"/>`;
                        }
                        i++;
                    }
                    return html;
                }

                // Fallback: no items
                const existing = q.answer_text || '';
                const existingNum = q.answer_number || '';
                switch (q.question_type) {
                    case 'yesno': {
                        const saved = q.answer_text || '';
                        return `${isTheImpact ? '' : '<div style="font-size:.8rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--teal);margin-bottom:.3rem">Please select one option:</div>'}
                        <label class="check-item"><input type="radio" name="admin_q${taskId}" value="yes" class="admin-input" ${saved === 'yes' ? 'checked' : ''} ${dis} onchange="markDirty(${taskId})"> Yes</label>
                        <label class="check-item"><input type="radio" name="admin_q${taskId}" value="no" class="admin-input" ${saved === 'no' ? 'checked' : ''} ${dis} onchange="markDirty(${taskId})"> No</label>`;
                    }
                    case 'url':
                        return `<div class="evidence-label">Link or URL:</div>
                        <div class="url-wrap">
                            <input class="url-input" type="url" id="input_${taskId}" value="${existing}" placeholder="https://..." ${locked ? 'readonly' : ''} style="${locked ? 'background:#f0f2f7;color:var(--subtext)' : ''}"/>
                        </div>`;
                    case 'number':
                        return `<div class="evidence-label">Value:</div>
                        <input class="txt-input" type="number" id="input_${taskId}" value="${existingNum}" placeholder="Enter number" style="width:200px;${locked ? 'background:#f0f2f7;color:var(--subtext)' : ''}" ${locked ? 'readonly' : ''}/>`;
                    case 'checkbox':
                        return `<label class="check-item"><input type="checkbox" id="input_${taskId}" ${existing === 'yes' ? 'checked' : ''} ${locked ? 'disabled' : ''}> Tick if applicable</label>`;
                    default:
                        return `<input class="txt-input" type="text" id="input_${taskId}" value="${existing}" placeholder="Enter answer" ${locked ? 'readonly' : ''} style="${locked ? 'background:#f0f2f7;color:var(--subtext)' : ''}"/>`;
                }
            }

            function buildWurInput(q, locked = false) {
                const taskId = q.task_id;
                const val = q.answer_number ?? '';
                const ls = locked ? 'background:#f0f2f7;color:var(--subtext)' : '';
                const ro = locked ? 'readonly' : '';
                return `<input class="txt-input" type="number" id="input_${taskId}" value="${val}" placeholder="â€”" style="width:150px;${ls}" ${ro}/>`;
            }

            function getAnswerValue(q) {
                const taskId = q.task_id;
                const items = q.items || [];

                // Standard 4-item FT/PT/HC/FTE equality grid
                if (items.length === 4 &&
                    items[0]?.label === 'Full Time' &&
                    items[1]?.label === 'Part Time' &&
                    document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_0`)) {
                    const ftVal = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_0`)?.value) || 0;
                    const ptVal = parseFloat(document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_1`)?.value) || 0;
                    return { answer_text: JSON.stringify({ ft: ftVal, pt: ptVal, hc: ftVal + ptVal, fte: Math.round(ftVal + (ptVal / 3)) }), answer_number: null };
                }

                // All other multi-item questions (including other grid questions)
                if (items.length > 0) {
                    const collected = {};
                    items.forEach((item, i) => {
                        if (item.answer_type === 'radio') {
                            const checked = document.querySelector(`input[name="radio_${taskId}"]:checked`);
                            if (checked) collected[i] = checked.value;
                            return;
                        }
                        const el = document.getElementById(`item_${taskId}_${i}`);
                        if (!el) return;
                        if (item.answer_type === 'checkbox') {
                            collected[i] = el.checked ? 'yes' : 'no';
                        } else if (item.answer_type === 'richtext' || item.answer_type === 'text') {
                            const quill = el._quill;
                            collected[i] = quill ? quill.root.innerHTML : (el.innerText || el.textContent || '');
                        } else {
                            collected[i] = el.value || '';
                        }
                    });

                    // Collect evidence and public for THE Impact
                    if (isTheImpact) {
                        const evidenceEl = document.getElementById(`evidence_${taskId}`);
                        if (evidenceEl) collected['evidence'] = evidenceEl.value || '';
                        const publicEl = document.getElementById(`public_${taskId}`);
                        if (publicEl) collected['public'] = publicEl.checked ? 'yes' : 'no';
                    }

                    if (Object.keys(collected).length === 1 && !isTheImpact) {
                        const item = items[0];
                        const val = collected[0];
                        if (item.answer_type === 'number') return { answer_text: null, answer_number: val ? parseFloat(val) : null };
                        return { answer_text: val || null, answer_number: null };
                    }
                    return { answer_text: JSON.stringify(collected), answer_number: null };
                }

                if (isTheWur) {
                    const val = document.getElementById(`input_${taskId}`)?.value || null;
                    return { answer_text: null, answer_number: val ? parseFloat(val) : null };
                }

                switch (q.question_type) {
                    case 'yesno': { const ch = document.querySelector(`input[name="admin_q${taskId}"]:checked`); return { answer_text: ch ? ch.value : null, answer_number: null }; } case 'url': { const val = document.getElementById(`input_${taskId}`)?.value || null; return { answer_text: val, answer_number: null }; }
                    case 'number': { const val = document.getElementById(`input_${taskId}`)?.value || null; return { answer_text: null, answer_number: val ? parseFloat(val) : null }; }
                    case 'checkbox': { const ch = document.getElementById(`input_${taskId}`)?.checked; return { answer_text: ch ? 'yes' : 'no', answer_number: null }; }
                    default: { const val = document.getElementById(`input_${taskId}`)?.value || null; return { answer_text: val, answer_number: null }; }
                }
            }

            const CROSS_VALIDATIONS = [
                {
                    sumCodes: ['FS2', 'FS3'],
                    totalCode: 'FS1',
                    label: 'Faculty Staff Male + Faculty Staff Female (HC) must equal Faculty Staff Total (HC)'
                },
                {
                    sumCodes: ['SD1', 'SD2'],
                    totalCode: 'SO1',
                    label: 'Students Male + Students Female must equal Students - Overall'
                }
            ];

            function validateCrossQuestions() {
                const errors = [];
                const qs = window.questions || [];

                for (const rule of CROSS_VALIDATIONS) {
                    const sumQs = rule.sumCodes.map(code => qs.find(q => q.code === code)).filter(Boolean);
                    const totalQ = qs.find(q => q.code === rule.totalCode);
                    if (!totalQ || sumQs.length !== rule.sumCodes.length) continue;

                    const getVal = (q, idx) => {
                        const el = document.getElementById(`item_${q.task_id}_${idx}`);
                        return parseFloat(el?.value) || 0;
                    };

                    // Check Full Time (index 0)
                    const ftVals = sumQs.map(q => getVal(q, 0));
                    const ftTotal = getVal(totalQ, 0);
                    const ftSum = ftVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

                    // Check Part Time (index 1)
                    const ptVals = sumQs.map(q => getVal(q, 1));
                    const ptTotal = getVal(totalQ, 1);
                    const ptSum = ptVals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

                    if (ftTotal === 0 && ptTotal === 0) continue; // skip if total not filled

                    if (ftSum !== ftTotal) {
                        errors.push(`âš ï¸ ${rule.label}\n   Full Time: ${ftVals.join(' + ')} = ${ftSum}, but overall total is ${ftTotal}`);
                    }

                    if (ptSum !== ptTotal) {
                        errors.push(`âš ï¸ ${rule.label}\n   Part Time: ${ptVals.join(' + ')} = ${ptSum}, but overall total is ${ptTotal}`);
                    }
                }
                return errors;
            }

            async function submitQuestion(taskId, btn) {
                const q = window.questions?.find(x => x.task_id === taskId);
                if (!q) return;
                const row = btn.closest('.q-row') || btn.closest('tr');
                const isEqRow = row && row.classList.contains('g-eq');

                if (btn.classList.contains('btn-edit')) {
                    q.task_status = 'pending';
                    if (row) {
                        if (isEqRow) {
                            row.outerHTML = window._renderEqualityRow(q);
                        } else {
                            const answerCell = row.querySelector('td:nth-child(2)') || row.children[1];
                            if (answerCell) answerCell.innerHTML = buildInput(q, false);
                            setTimeout(initQuillEditors, 0);
                            // Enable evidence and public fields for THE Impact
                            if (isTheImpact) {
                                const evidenceEl = row.querySelector(`#evidence_${q.task_id}`);
                                if (evidenceEl) { evidenceEl.removeAttribute('readonly'); evidenceEl.style.background = ''; }
                                const publicEl = row.querySelector(`#public_${q.task_id}`);
                                if (publicEl) { publicEl.disabled = false; }
                            }
                            btn.textContent = 'Submit';
                            btn.classList.remove('btn-edit');
                            btn.classList.add('btn-submit-row');
                        }
                    }
                    return;
                }

                const errors = validateCrossQuestions();
                if (errors.length) {
                    showFormAlert('Please fix the following before submitting:\n\n' + errors.join('\n'));
                    return;
                }
                const answerData = getAnswerValue(q);
                try {
                    btn.textContent = '...'; btn.disabled = true;
                    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/submissions/submit`, {
                        method: 'POST',
                        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
                        body: JSON.stringify({ task_assignment_id: taskId, answers: answerData, user_id: user.id })
                    });
                    const data = await res.json();
                    if (data.success) {
                        q.answer_text = answerData.answer_text;
                        q.answer_number = answerData.answer_number;
                        q.task_status = 'submitted';
                        q.answer_updated_at = new Date().toISOString();
                        btn.textContent = 'âœ“ Saved';
                        btn.style.background = 'var(--teal)';
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            btn.textContent = 'âœŽ Edit';
                            btn.classList.remove('btn-submit-row');
                            btn.classList.add('btn-edit');
                            btn.style.background = '';
                            btn.disabled = false;
                            if (isGreenMetric) {
                                renderStandardQuestions(allQuestions.filter(q => q.gm_category === activeGMTab));
                            } else if (isTheImpact) {
                                renderStandardQuestions(allQuestions.filter(q => q.theme === activeImpactTab));
                            } else {
                                renderStandardQuestions(allQuestions);
                            }
                        }, 1500);
                    } else {
                        btn.textContent = 'Submit'; btn.disabled = false;
                        alert(data.error || 'Failed to save');
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    btn.textContent = 'Submit'; btn.disabled = false;
                    alert('Server error');
                }
            }

            function groupByTheme(questions) {
                const groups = {}, order = [];
                questions.forEach(q => { const key = q.theme || 'General'; if (!groups[key]) { groups[key] = []; order.push(key); } groups[key].push(q); });
                return order.map(k => [k, groups[k]]);
            }

            const SUB_SECTION_MAP = {
                'AR': 'Annual Report', 'ES': 'Environmental Sustainability',
                'EE': 'Environmental Education', 'ER': 'Environmental Research',
                'EQ': 'Equality', 'DI': 'Equality', 'ST': 'Equality',
                'KE': 'Knowledge Exchange', 'HW': 'Health and Wellbeing',
                'GG': 'Good Governance', 'AI': 'Additional Information'
            };
            const THEMES_WITH_SUBSECTIONS = ['Environmental Impact', 'Social Impact', 'Governance'];

            function getSubSection(code) {
                const prefix = (code || '').match(/^[A-Z]+/)?.[0] || '';
                return SUB_SECTION_MAP[prefix] || null;
            }

                function renderEqualityRow(q) {
                    const locked = q.task_status && q.task_status !== 'pending' && q.task_status !== 'rejected';
                    const updatedAt = formatDate(q.answer_updated_at);
                    const tid = q.task_id;
                    const ls = locked ? 'background:#f0f2f7;color:var(--subtext)' : '';
                    const ro = locked ? 'readonly' : '';
                    const items = q.items || [];

                    // Parse saved values â€” support both {ft,pt,hc,fte} and generic {0,1,2,...} formats
                    let existingVals = items.map(() => '');
                    if (q.answer_text) {
                        try {
                            const p = JSON.parse(q.answer_text);
                            if ('ft' in p) {
                                existingVals[0] = p.ft ?? '';
                                existingVals[1] = p.pt ?? '';
                                existingVals[2] = p.hc ?? '';
                                existingVals[3] = p.fte ?? '';
                            } else {
                                items.forEach((_, i) => { existingVals[i] = p[i] ?? p[String(i)] ?? ''; });
                            }
                        } catch (e) { }
                    }

                    // Standard 4-item FT/PT/HC/FTE â€” HC and FTE are auto-calculated
                    const isStandardEq = items.length === 4 && items[0]?.label === 'Full Time' && items[1]?.label === 'Part Time';
                    const calcStyle = 'background:#f0f2f7;color:var(--subtext)';

                    let inputs = '';
                    if (isStandardEq) {
                        inputs = `
                            <div><input class="eq-input" type="number" id="item_${tid}_0" placeholder="â€”" value="${existingVals[0]}" style="${ls}" ${ro} oninput="calcEq(${tid})"/></div>
                            <div><input class="eq-input" type="number" id="item_${tid}_1" placeholder="â€”" value="${existingVals[1]}" style="${ls}" ${ro} oninput="calcEq(${tid})"/></div>
                            <div><input class="eq-input" type="number" id="item_${tid}_2" placeholder="â€”" value="${existingVals[2]}" style="${calcStyle}" readonly/></div>
                            <div><input class="eq-input" type="number" id="item_${tid}_3" placeholder="â€”" value="${existingVals[3]}" style="${calcStyle}" readonly/></div>`;
                    } else {
                        // Generic multi-number grid â€” all editable
                        inputs = items.map((item, i) =>
                            `<div><input class="eq-input" type="number" id="item_${tid}_${i}" placeholder="â€”" value="${existingVals[i]}" style="${ls}" ${ro}/></div>`
                        ).join('');
                    }

                    const actionBtn = locked
                        ? `<button class="btn-edit"       onclick="submitQuestion(${tid}, this)">âœŽ Edit</button>`
                        : `<button class="btn-submit-row" onclick="submitQuestion(${tid}, this)">Submit</button>`;

                    return `<div class="q-row g-eq"
                        data-title="${q.title.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}"
                        data-desc="${(q.description || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}"
                        data-taskid="${q.task_id || ''}"
                        onclick="selectRow(this)">
                        <div class="q-text">${q.title}${q.is_synced ? ' <span style="color:var(--teal);font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700" title="This answer syncs across ranking forms">â†”</span>' : ''}</div>
                        ${inputs}
                        <div class="status-cell">${getStatusDot(q.task_status)}
    ${(q.submitted_at && updatedAt !== 'â€”') ? `<div style="font-size:.68rem;color:var(--subtext);margin-top:.25rem">â†» ${updatedAt}</div>` : ''}
</div>
                        <div class="date-cell">${q.deadline ? formatDate(q.deadline) : 'â€”'}</div>
                        <div class="action-cell">
                            ${actionBtn}
                            
                        </div>
                    </div>`;
                }

                window._renderEqualityRow = renderEqualityRow;

                let secIdx = 0;
                const html = groups.map(([theme, qs]) => {
                    const sid = 'sec_' + (secIdx++);
                    const answered = qs.filter(q => q.task_status && q.task_status !== 'pending').length;
                    const useSubSections = THEMES_WITH_SUBSECTIONS.includes(theme);
                    let rowsHtml = '';
                    const hdr = getTableHeaderColor();
                    const subHdrStyle = hdr ? `background:${hdr.bg} !important;border-bottom:2px solid ${hdr.border} !important;color:${hdr.text} !important` : '';
                    if (useSubSections) {
                        const subGroups = {}, subOrder = [];
                        qs.forEach(q => { const sub = getSubSection(q.code) || theme; if (!subGroups[sub]) { subGroups[sub] = []; subOrder.push(sub); } subGroups[sub].push(q); });

                        subOrder.forEach(sub => {
                            const subQs = subGroups[sub];
                            const isEquality = sub === 'Equality';

                            if (isEquality) {
                                const gridQs = subQs.filter(q => /^EQ[1-9]$/.test(q.code) && (q.items || []).length === 4);
                                const normalQs = subQs.filter(q => !(/^EQ[1-9]$/.test(q.code) && (q.items || []).length === 4));

                                if (gridQs.length) {
                                    rowsHtml += `<div class="subsec-hdr g-eq""><div>Equality</div><div>Full Time</div><div>Part Time</div><div>HC</div><div>FTE</div><div>Status</div><div>Due Date</div><div>Action</div></div>`;
                                    gridQs.forEach(q => { rowsHtml += renderEqualityRow(q); });
                                }
                                if (normalQs.length) {
                                    rowsHtml += `<div class="subsec-hdr g-main"><div>Equality</div><div style="text-align:left">${isGreenMetric ? 'Answer' : 'URL / Response'}</div><div>Status</div><div>Due Date</div><div>Action</div></div>`;
                                    normalQs.forEach(q => { rowsHtml += isGridQuestion(q) ? renderEqualityRow(q) : renderRow(q); });
                                }
                            } else {

            function renderWurSections(questions) {
                const hdr = getTableHeaderColor();
                const container = document.getElementById('sectionsContainer');
                if (!questions.length) {
                    container.innerHTML = `<div style="text-align:center;padding:3rem;color:var(--subtext)"><div style="font-size:2rem;margin-bottom:.5rem">ðŸ“‹</div><div style="font-weight:600">No THE WUR questions assigned to your department yet.</div></div>`;
                    window.questions = []; return;
                }
                const subjectMap = {};
                questions.forEach(q => { const s = q.theme || 'General'; if (!subjectMap[s]) subjectMap[s] = []; subjectMap[s].push(q); });
                Object.values(subjectMap).forEach(qs => qs.sort((a, b) => (a.kpi_index || 0) - (b.kpi_index || 0)));
                const orderedSubjects = THE_WUR_SUBJECTS.filter(s => subjectMap[s]);
                let secIdx = 0;
                container.innerHTML = orderedSubjects.map(subject => {
                    const qs = subjectMap[subject];
                    const sid = 'wur_' + (secIdx++);
                    const answered = qs.filter(q => q.task_status && q.task_status !== 'pending').length;
                    const rows = qs.map((q, i) => {
                        const locked = q.task_status && q.task_status !== 'pending';
                        const updatedAt = formatDate(q.answer_updated_at);
                        const inputHtml = buildWurInput(q, locked);
                        const actionBtn = locked
                            ? `<button class="btn-edit" onclick="submitQuestion(${q.task_id}, this)">âœŽ Edit</button>`
                            : `<button class="btn-submit-row" onclick="submitQuestion(${q.task_id}, this)">Submit</button>`;
                        return `<div class="q-row g-wur"
                            data-title="${q.title.replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}"
                            data-desc="${(q.description || '').replace(/"/g, '&quot;')}"
                            data-taskid="${q.task_id || ''}"
                            onclick="selectRow(this)">
                            <div class="q-text">${q.title}</div>
                            <div>${inputHtml}</div>
                            <div class="status-cell">${getStatusDot(q.task_status)}
                                ${(q.submitted_at && updatedAt !== 'â€”') ? `<div style="font-size:.68rem;color:var(--subtext);margin-top:.25rem">â†» ${updatedAt}</div>` : ''}
                            </div>
                            <div class="date-cell">${q.deadline ? formatDate(q.deadline) : 'â€”'}</div>
                            <div class="action-cell">
                                ${actionBtn}
                            </div>
                        </div>`;
                    }).join('');
                    const hdr = getTableHeaderColor();
                    const subHdrStyle = hdr ? `background:${hdr.bg};border-bottom:2px solid ${hdr.border};color:${hdr.text}` : '';
                    return `<div class="sec-block">
                        <div class="sec-hdr" onclick="toggleSec('${sid}')">
                            <span class="sec-hdr-title">${subject}</span>
                            <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem">
                                <span style="font-size:.75rem;color:var(--subtext)">${answered}/${qs.length} answered</span>
                                <span class="sec-tog" id="tog_${sid}">â–²</span>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                        <div id="body_${sid}">
                            <div class="subsec-hdr g-wur">
                                <div>${subject}</div>
                                <div style="text-align:left">URL / Response</div>
                                <div>Status</div>
                                <div>Due Date</div>
                                <div>Action</div>

            async function loadCycleInfo() {
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/questions/my-rankings/${cycleId}`, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } });
                    const cycle = await res.json();
                    if (cycle) {
                        document.getElementById('pageTitle').textContent = cycle.name;
                        document.title = cycle.name + ' â€“ UoB Rankings Tracker';
                        document.getElementById('pageSub').textContent = `Complete your assigned questions with supporting evidence`;
                        document.getElementById('deadlineBanner').innerHTML = `ðŸ—“ï¸ <strong>${cycle.name}</strong> â€” Deadline: <strong>${formatDate(cycle.deadline)}</strong>`;
                        highlightNavType(cycle.name);
                        const name = (cycle.name || '').toLowerCase();
                        isGreenMetric = name.includes('greenmetric');
                        isTheImpact = name.includes('impact');
                        isTheWur = name.includes('the world') || name.includes('the wur') || name.includes('times higher');

                        currentCycleName = cycle.name || '';
                        const hdr = getTableHeaderColor();
                        if (hdr) {
                            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--tab-active-color', hdr.text);
                            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cycle-hdr-bg', hdr.bg);
                            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cycle-hdr-border', hdr.border);
                            document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--cycle-hdr-text', hdr.text);
                        }

                        if (isGreenMetric) {
                            document.getElementById('gmTabsWrap').style.display = 'block';
                            document.querySelector('.def-panel').style.display = 'none';
                        } else if (isTheImpact) {
                            document.getElementById('impactTabsWrap').style.display = 'block';
                            document.querySelector('.def-panel').style.display = 'none';
                        } else {
                            document.querySelector('.def-panel').style.display = '';
                        }
                    }
                } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
            }

            async function loadQuestions() {
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/questions/my-questions/${cycleId}`, { headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } });
                    allQuestions = await res.json();
                } catch (e) {
                    document.getElementById('sectionsContainer').innerHTML = '<div style="text-align:center;padding:3rem;color:var(--subtext)">Failed to load questions. Make sure the server is running.</div>';
                    return;
                }
                const hasKpiIndex = allQuestions.some(q => q.kpi_index != null);
                if (hasKpiIndex) isTheWur = true;

                // Show all GM tabs; default to the first tab that has questions, else SI
                if (isGreenMetric) {
                    const assignedCats = new Set(allQuestions.map(q => q.gm_category).filter(Boolean));
                    const firstAssigned = ['SI', 'EC', 'WS', 'WR', 'TR', 'ED', 'GD'].find(cat => assignedCats.has(cat));
                    if (firstAssigned) {
                        activeGMTab = firstAssigned;
                        document.querySelectorAll('.gm-tab').forEach(tab => {
                            tab.classList.toggle('active', tab.dataset.cat === firstAssigned);
                        });
                    }
                }
                if (isTheWur) {
                    renderWurSections(allQuestions);
                } else if (isGreenMetric) {
                    const firstTabQuestions = allQuestions.filter(q => q.gm_category === activeGMTab);
                    renderStandardQuestions(firstTabQuestions);
                } else if (isTheImpact) {
                    const firstTabQuestions = allQuestions.filter(q => q.theme === activeImpactTab);
                    renderStandardQuestions(firstTabQuestions);
                } else {
                    renderStandardQuestions(allQuestions);
                }
            }

            function openModal() { document.getElementById('submitModal').classList.add('show'); document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden'; }
            function closeModal() { document.getElementById('submitModal').classList.remove('show'); document.body.style.overflow = ''; }
            function closeModalOnOverlay(e) { if (e.target === document.getElementById('submitModal')) closeModal(); }

            async function submitAll() {
                closeModal();
                const errors = validateCrossQuestions();
                if (errors.length) {
                    showFormAlert('Please fix the following before submitting:\n\n' + errors.join('\n'));
                    return;
                }
                const qs = window.questions || [];
                let success = 0;
                for (const q of qs) {
                    const answerData = getAnswerValue(q);
                    try {
                        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/submissions/submit`, {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` },
                            body: JSON.stringify({ task_assignment_id: q.task_id, answers: answerData, user_id: user.id })
                        });
                        const data = await res.json();
                        if (data.success) success++;
                    } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
                }
                showFormAlert(`âœ“ ${success}/${qs.length} questions submitted successfully!`, 'success');
                loadQuestions();
            }

            function logout() {
                fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/logout`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } });
                localStorage.clear();
                window.location.href = 'login.html';
            }

            function toggleForms() {
                const el = document.getElementById('navForms');
                const ar = document.getElementById('formsArrow');
                el.classList.toggle('open');
                ar.textContent = el.classList.contains('open') ? 'â–´' : 'â–¾';
            }

            function switchGMTab(el, cat) {
                document.querySelectorAll('.gm-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                el.classList.add('active');
                activeGMTab = cat;
                const filtered = allQuestions.filter(q => q.gm_category === cat);
                renderStandardQuestions(filtered);
            }

            function switchImpactTab(el, theme) {
                document.querySelectorAll('#impactTabsWrap .gm-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
                el.classList.add('active');
                activeImpactTab = theme;
                const filtered = allQuestions.filter(q => q.theme === theme);
                renderStandardQuestions(filtered);
            }

            function formatGMCode(code) {
                if (!code) return '';
                const parts = code.split('_');
                if (parts.length >= 3) return `${parts[1]}.${parts[2]}`;
                return '';
            }

            function formatGMTitle(title) {
                if (!title.includes(' â€” ')) return title;
                const [main, rest] = title.split(' â€” ');
                return `${main}<br><span style="font-size:.72rem;color:var(--subtext);font-style:italic">${rest}</span>`;
            }

            function highlightNavType(cycleName) {
                const name = (cycleName || '').toLowerCase();
                let id = '';
                if (name.includes('sustainability')) id = 'nav-sustainability';
                else if (name.includes('world university') && name.includes('qs')) id = 'nav-qs-wur';
                else if (name.includes('world university')) id = 'nav-the-wur';
                else if (name.includes('impact')) id = 'nav-the-impact';
                else if (name.includes('greenmetric')) id = 'nav-greenmetric';
                if (id) document.getElementById(id)?.classList.add('active');
            }

            async function wireSidebarLinks() {
                try {
                    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/questions/my-rankings`, {
                        headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
                    });
                    const rankings = await res.json();
                    if (!Array.isArray(rankings)) return;

                    function navType(name) {
                        const n = (name || '').toLowerCase();
                        if (n.includes('greenmetric')) return 'greenmetric';
                        if (n.includes('impact')) return 'the-impact';
                        if (n.includes('sustainability')) return 'sustainability';
                        if (n.includes('qs') && n.includes('world')) return 'qs-wur';
                        if (n.includes('the') && n.includes('world')) return 'the-wur';
                        if (n.includes('qs')) return 'qs-wur';
                        return n;
                    }

                    const navIds = {
                        'sustainability': 'nav-qs-sus',
                        'qs-wur': 'nav-qs-wur',
                        'the-wur': 'nav-the-wur',
                        'impact': 'nav-the-impact',
                        'greenmetric': 'nav-greenmetric'
                    };

                    const latestByType = {};
                    rankings.forEach(r => {
                        const t = navType(r.name);
                        if (!latestByType[t] || (r.year || 0) > (latestByType[t].year || 0)) {
                            latestByType[t] = r;
                        }
                    });

                    Object.keys(latestByType).forEach(type => {
                        const el = document.getElementById('nav-' + type);
                        if (!el) return;
                        const cycle = latestByType[type];
                        el.href = cycle ? `form.html?cycle=${cycle.id}` : 'ranking-forms.html';
                    });
                } catch (e) {
                    console.error(e);
                }
            }

            function updateLegendCounts() {
                const qs = allQuestions || [];
                let submitted = 0, accepted = 0, pending = 0, rejected = 0, nostatus = 0;
                qs.forEach(q => {
                    const s = q.task_status;
                    if (s === 'submitted') submitted++;
                    else if (s === 'accepted') accepted++;
                    else if (s === 'pending') pending++;
                    else if (s === 'rejected') rejected++;
                    else nostatus++;
                });
                document.getElementById('count-submitted').textContent = `(${submitted})`;
                document.getElementById('count-accepted').textContent = `(${accepted})`;
                document.getElementById('count-pending').textContent = `(${pending})`;
                document.getElementById('count-rejected').textContent = `(${rejected})`;
                document.getElementById('count-nostatus').textContent = `(${nostatus})`;
            }

            function showFormAlert(msg, type = 'error') {
                const existing = document.getElementById('_formAlert');
                if (existing) existing.remove();
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.id = '_formAlert';
                const isSuccess = type === 'success';
                div.style.cssText = `position:fixed;top:80px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
                    background:${isSuccess ? '#f0fdf4' : '#fef2f2'};
                    border:1px solid ${isSuccess ? '#bbf7d0' : '#fecaca'};
                    color:${isSuccess ? '#065f46' : '#991b1b'};
                    padding:.75rem 1.4rem;border-radius:10px;font-size:.84rem;z-index:2000;
                    max-width:480px;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.15);line-height:1.6;
                    white-space:pre-line;font-weight:500`;
                div.textContent = msg;
                document.body.appendChild(div);
                setTimeout(() => div.remove(), isSuccess ? 4000 : 7000);
            }

            loadCycleInfo().then(() => loadQuestions());
            wireSidebarLinks();
        </script>
</body>

<script>
  // --- Loader ---
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      document.getElementById('loader').classList.add('hidden');
    }, 1500);
  });

  // --- Custom Cursor ---
  const dot = document.getElementById('cursorDot');
  const ring = document.getElementById('cursorRing');
  let mouseX = 0, mouseY = 0;
  let ringX = 0, ringY = 0;

  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    mouseX = e.clientX;
    mouseY = e.clientY;
    dot.style.transform = `translate(${mouseX}px, ${mouseY}px) translate(-50%, -50%)`;
  });

  function animateRing() {
    ringX += (mouseX - ringX) * 0.15;
    ringY += (mouseY - ringY) * 0.15;
    ring.style.transform = `translate(${ringX}px, ${ringY}px) translate(-50%, -50%)`;
    requestAnimationFrame(animateRing);
  }
  animateRing();

  // Cursor hover effects
  const hoverables = document.querySelectorAll('a, button, .bento-card, .gallery-card, .gallery-item');
  hoverables.forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => ring.classList.add('hover'));
    el.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => ring.classList.remove('hover'));
  });

  // --- Scroll Reveal ---
  const reveals = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  const revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries.forEach(entry => {
      if (entry.isIntersecting) {
        entry.target.classList.add('active');
        if(entry.target.classList.contains('bento-card')) {
           entry.target.classList.add('active');
        }
      }
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.15 });
  reveals.forEach(el => revealObserver.observe(el));

  // --- Horizontal Scroll Logic ---
  const gallerySection = document.querySelector('.gallery-section');
  const galleryTrack = document.getElementById('galleryTrack');

  function updateHorizontalScroll() {
    const rect = gallerySection.getBoundingClientRect();
    const sectionHeight = gallerySection.offsetHeight;
    const viewportHeight = window.innerHeight;
    const scrollableDistance = sectionHeight - viewportHeight;

    if (rect.top <= 0 && rect.bottom >= viewportHeight) {
      const progress = Math.abs(rect.top) / scrollableDistance;
      const trackWidth = galleryTrack.scrollWidth;
      const viewWidth = window.innerWidth;
      const maxTranslate = trackWidth - viewWidth + 100;
      
      galleryTrack.style.transform = `translate3d(${-progress * maxTranslate}px, 0, 0)`;
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('scroll', updateHorizontalScroll);
  window.addEventListener('resize', updateHorizontalScroll);

  // --- Bento Card Glow Follow ---
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.bento-card');
  cards.forEach(card => {
    card.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const rect = card.getBoundingClientRect();
      const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
      const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
      card.style.setProperty('--x', `${x}px`);
      card.style.setProperty('--y', `${y}px`);
    });
  });
</script>

  <script>
    const API_BASE = location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
      ? 'http://localhost:3002'
      : 'https://uob-rankings.onrender.com';

    function togglePwd() {
      const pwd = document.getElementById('password');
      const btnIcon = document.querySelector('#eyeBtn i');
      if (pwd.type === 'password') { 
        pwd.type = 'text'; 
        btnIcon.classList.remove('fa-eye');
        btnIcon.classList.add('fa-eye-slash');
      } else { 
        pwd.type = 'password'; 
        btnIcon.classList.remove('fa-eye-slash');
        btnIcon.classList.add('fa-eye');
      }
    }

    function fillDemo(email, password) {
      document.getElementById('email').value = email;
      document.getElementById('password').value = password;
      document.getElementById('userError').classList.remove('show');
      document.getElementById('passError').classList.remove('show');
    }

    // --- FORGOT PASSWORD MODAL LOGIC ---
    function openForgotPassword() {
      const modal = document.getElementById('forgotPasswordModal');
      modal.classList.add('show');
      document.getElementById('resetEmail').value = document.getElementById('email').value; // Pre-fill if exists
      document.getElementById('resetError').classList.remove('show');
      document.getElementById('resetSuccess').classList.remove('show');
    }

    function closeForgotPassword() {
      document.getElementById('forgotPasswordModal').classList.remove('show');
    }

    async function handleForgotPassword() {
      const email = document.getElementById('resetEmail').value.trim();
      const errorEl = document.getElementById('resetError');
      const successEl = document.getElementById('resetSuccess');

      errorEl.classList.remove('show');
      successEl.classList.remove('show');

      if (!email || !email.includes('@')) {
        errorEl.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
        errorEl.classList.add('show');
        return;
      }

      try {
        // Replace with your actual forgot password endpoint
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/forgot-password`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email })
        });

        if (res.ok) {
          successEl.textContent = 'If an account exists, a reset link has been sent.';
          successEl.classList.add('show');
          setTimeout(() => closeForgotPassword(), 2500);
        } else {
          const data = await res.json();
          errorEl.textContent = data.error || 'Failed to send reset link. Please try again.';
          errorEl.classList.add('show');
        }
      } catch (err) {
        // Fallback for demo purposes if endpoint doesn't exist yet
        console.warn('Forgot password API not reachable, showing mock success:', err);
        successEl.textContent = 'Mock: Reset link sent! (Connect API endpoint)';
        successEl.classList.add('show');
        setTimeout(() => closeForgotPassword(), 2500);
      }
    }
    // -------------------------------------

    async function doSignIn() {
      const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
      const password = document.getElementById('password').value.trim();

      document.getElementById('userError').classList.remove('show');
      document.getElementById('passError').classList.remove('show');

      if (!email) { 
        document.getElementById('userError').classList.add('show'); 
        return; 
      }
      if (!password) { 
        document.getElementById('passError').classList.add('show'); 
        return; 
      }

      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/login`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
          body: JSON.stringify({ email, password })
        });

        const data = await res.json();

        if (!res.ok) {
          document.getElementById('passError').textContent = data.error || 'Invalid email or password.';
          document.getElementById('passError').classList.add('show');
          document.querySelector('.form-wrap').classList.add('shake');
          setTimeout(() => document.querySelector('.form-wrap').classList.remove('shake'), 400);
          return;
        }

        localStorage.setItem('token', data.token);
        localStorage.setItem('user', JSON.stringify(data.user));

        document.getElementById('successName').textContent = 'Welcome, ' + data.user.name;
        document.getElementById('successScreen').classList.add('show');

        setTimeout(() => {
          if (data.user.role === 'admin') {
            window.location.href = 'dashboard-admin.html';
          } else {
            window.location.href = 'dashboard-dept.html';
          }
        }, 2200);

      } catch (err) {
        document.getElementById('passError').textContent = 'Could not connect to server.';
        document.getElementById('passError').classList.add('show');
      }
    }

    // Close modal if clicking outside
    document.getElementById('forgotPasswordModal').addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      if (e.target === this) {
        closeForgotPassword();
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

===== C:\Users\User\UOB-Rankings\migrate.js =====
const db = require('./db');

async function runMigration() {
  console.log('ðŸš€ Connecting to Turso to add password reset columns...\n');
  
  const columnsToAdd = [
    { name: 'reset_otp', type: 'TEXT' },
    { name: 'reset_token', type: 'TEXT' },
    { name: 'reset_expires_at', type: 'TEXT' }
  ];

  for (const col of columnsToAdd) {
    try {
      await db.execute({ 
        sql: `ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN ${col.name} ${col.type}` 
      });
      console.log(`âœ… Successfully added column to Turso: ${col.name}`);
    } catch (err) {
      // Turso/SQLite throws a specific error if the column already exists
      if (err.message && err.message.toLowerCase().includes('duplicate column name')) {
        console.log(`â„¹ï¸ Column '${col.name}' already exists in Turso. Skipping.`);
      } else {
        console.error(`âŒ Failed to add column '${col.name}':`, err.message);
      }
    }
  }
  
  console.log('\nðŸŽ‰ Migration complete! Your Turso database is now ready.');
  process.exit(0);
}

runMigration();

  <script>
    const API_BASE = location.hostname === 'localhost' || location.hostname === '127.0.0.1'
      ? 'http://localhost:3002'
      : 'https://uob-rankings.onrender.com';

    const token = localStorage.getItem('token');
    const user = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('user') || '{}');
    if (!token) window.location.href = 'login.html';

    // Display user info
    document.getElementById('userName').textContent = user.name || 'User';
    document.querySelector('.user-role').textContent = user.role === 'admin' ? 'Administrator' : 'Department User';
    const initials = (user.name || 'U').split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').toUpperCase().slice(0, 2);
    document.getElementById('userAvatar').textContent = initials;

    // Sidebar toggle
    function toggleSidebar() {
      const sidebar = document.getElementById('sidebar');
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) {
        sidebar.classList.toggle('mobile-open');
      } else {
        sidebar.classList.toggle('collapsed');
      }
    }

    function toggleCycles() {
      const el = document.getElementById('navCycles');
      const ar = document.getElementById('cyclesArrow');
      el.classList.toggle('open');
      ar.style.transform = el.classList.contains('open') ? 'rotate(180deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)';
    }

    // Logout
    document.getElementById('logoutBtn').addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      try {
        await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/auth/logout`, { method: 'POST', headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` } });
      } catch (e) { console.error(e); }
      localStorage.removeItem('token');
      localStorage.removeItem('user');
      window.location.href = 'login.html';
    });

    // â”€â”€ Helpers â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    function getColor(name) {
      const n = (name || '').toLowerCase();
      if (n.includes('greenmetric')) return 'var(--green)'; 
      if (n.includes('impact')) return 'var(--supporting-red)'; 
      if (n.includes('sustainability')) return 'var(--primary-blue)'; 
      if (n.includes('qs')) return 'var(--primary-gold)'; 
      if (n.includes('the') && n.includes('world')) return 'var(--bright-blue)'; 
      return 'var(--primary-blue)';
    }

    function formatDate(d) {
      if (!d) return 'â€”';
      const dt = new Date(d);
      if (isNaN(dt)) return 'â€”';
      return dt.toLocaleDateString('en-GB', { day: 'numeric', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
    }

    // â”€â”€ Load progress data â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
    async function loadProgress() {
      const grid = document.getElementById('cardsGrid');
      try {
        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/api/questions/my-rankings`, {
          headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}` }
        });
        let rankings = await res.json();

        // Wire sidebar type links
        function rankingType(name) {
          const n = (name || '').toLowerCase();
          if (n.includes('greenmetric')) return 'greenmetric';
          if (n.includes('impact')) return 'the-impact';
          if (n.includes('sustainability')) return 'sustainability';
          if (n.includes('qs') && n.includes('world')) return 'qs-wur';
          if (n.includes('the') && n.includes('world')) return 'the-wur';
          if (n.includes('qs')) return 'qs-wur';
          return n;
        }

        if (Array.isArray(rankings)) {
          const latestByType = {};
          rankings.forEach(r => {
            const t = rankingType(r.name);
            if (!latestByType[t] || (r.year || 0) > (latestByType[t].year || 0)) {
              latestByType[t] = r;
            }
          });
          Object.keys(latestByType).forEach(type => {
            const el = document.getElementById('nav-' + type);
            if (!el) return;
            const cycle = latestByType[type];
            el.href = cycle ? `form.html?cycle=${cycle.id}` : 'ranking-forms.html';
          });
        }

        // Keep only the most recent year
        if (Array.isArray(rankings) && rankings.length) {
          const maxYear = Math.max(...rankings.map(r => r.year || 0));
          rankings = rankings.filter(r => (r.year || 0) === maxYear);
        }

        if (!Array.isArray(rankings) || !rankings.length) {
          grid.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:3rem;color:var(--text-secondary)">
            <i class="fas fa-chart-pie" style="font-size: 2.5rem; color: var(--light-blue); margin-bottom: 1rem; display: block;"></i>
            <div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:.3rem; font-size: 1.1rem; color: var(--text-primary);">No ranking forms assigned yet</div>
            <div style="font-size:.88rem">Your progress will appear here once questions are assigned to your department.</div>
          </div>`;
          return;
        }

        const circumference = 2 * Math.PI * 60; // r = 60
        grid.innerHTML = rankings.map(r => {
          const assigned = r.assigned || 0;
          const submitted = r.submitted || 0;
          const pct = assigned ? Math.round((submitted / assigned) * 100) : 0;
          const color = getColor(r.name);
          const dash = (pct / 100) * circumference;
          const nextDue = formatDate(r.next_due || r.deadline);
          const deadlineLine = r.outstanding > 0
            ? `<div class="card-deadline"><i class="fas fa-calendar-alt"></i> Next due: ${nextDue}</div>`
            : `<div class="card-deadline" style="color: var(--green);"><i class="fas fa-check-circle"></i> All questions answered</div>`;

          return `
          <a class="prog-card" href="form.html?cycle=${r.id}">
            <div class="donut-wrap">
              <svg viewBox="0 0 160 160">
                <circle class="donut-bg" cx="80" cy="80" r="60" />
                <circle class="donut-fill" cx="80" cy="80" r="60" stroke="${color}"
                stroke-dasharray="${dash} ${circumference}" stroke-dashoffset="0" />
              </svg>
              <div class="donut-pct">${pct}%</div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-name-row">
              <div class="card-dot" style="background:${color}"></div>
              <div class="card-name">${r.name}</div>
            </div>
            <div class="card-detail">${submitted} / ${assigned} answered</div>
            <div class="prog-bar-wrap">
              <div class="prog-bar" style="width:${pct}%;background:${color}"></div>
            </div>
            ${deadlineLine}
          </a>`;
        }).join('');
      } catch (e) {
        console.error(e);
        grid.innerHTML = `<div style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:3rem;color:var(--supporting-red)">Failed to load progress.</div>`;
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      loadProgress();
      // Open cycles menu by default
      document.getElementById('navCycles').classList.add('open');
      document.getElementById('cyclesArrow').style.transform = 'rotate(180deg)';
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    function getConfig(name) {
      const n = name.toLowerCase();
      if (n.includes('greenmetric')) return rankingConfig['GreenMetric'];
      if (n.includes('impact')) return rankingConfig['THE Impact'];
      if (n.includes('qs') && n.includes('sustainability')) return rankingConfig['QS Sustainability'];
      if (n.includes('qs')) return rankingConfig['QS WUR'];
      if (n.includes('the') && n.includes('world')) return rankingConfig['THE WUR'];
      return rankingConfig['QS WUR'];
